title: Nebius Reports Thursday as the Neocloud Rally Meets December Hike Math
dek: Nebius's third-quarter report lands before the open Thursday, after CoreWeave lifted the group on Wednesday. The stock's reaction will test how much higher rates the AI-infrastructure trade can absorb.
author: Meridian Newsroom

body:
**Update, Nov. 12:** Nebius reported before the open and shares fell 16% on Thursday; see the results story for the actual numbers. The preview below was written before the report. Nebius Group was due to report its third-quarter results before the market opened on Thursday, Nov. 12. The report arrives one day after CoreWeave's results lifted the neocloud group, a set of companies that run cloud infrastructure built only for AI workloads.

## The numbers Wall Street expects

GuruFocus and TradingView put the consensus revenue estimate at roughly $905 million to $907 million. TradingKey's preview gave $907 million and said that would be an increase of more than 500% from a year earlier. TipRanks reported that analysts expect an adjusted loss of $0.72 per share, against a loss of $0.41 in the same quarter last year. Those figures are preview consensus and can change before the release.

## Why the stock moved first

Yahoo Finance said Nebius rose about 15% in early trading Wednesday after CoreWeave's report. CoreWeave's raised outlook and its disclosure of about $9 billion in customer prepayments over the next three months eased worries about how the group will fund its expansion. TipRanks noted that Nebius shares were up about 60% year to date.

## The rate-hike problem

The rally is happening against a rate backdrop that cuts the other way. CNN reported that CME FedWatch odds on Tuesday put a quarter-point December hike at 91%, with a half-point move at 9%. Yahoo Finance quoted Fed Governor Michelle Bowman on Tuesday saying there was still work to do to bring inflation closer to 2%. Long-duration growth stocks such as neoclouds are sensitive to higher discount rates, and the 10-year Treasury closed Tuesday at 4.98%, per CNN Business.

## What would change the read

A strong Nebius print would support the view that AI infrastructure demand can carry these companies through a tighter rate path. A weak revenue print or a larger loss would test the same stocks at a time when investors are already paying close attention to financing costs. Treasury trading resumes Thursday, so the bond market's reaction to the CPI-driven hike repricing will arrive on the same day.

marketImpact.summary: Nebius is the next test of whether the neocloud rally rests on demand or on financing relief. Higher hike odds raise the bar for any stock that depends on cheap capital.
marketImpact.timeframe: Thursday, Nov. 12, pre-market report and Treasury reopening
